messages:
Nadia (PM): Kicking off a short thread on two complementary packaging ideas: 'Priority Windows' (timeboxed per-route priority) and 'Surge Shield' (credits that trigger fallbacks). Need quick alignment on scope, pricing shapes, and launch gates.

Owen (Eng): Technical distinction important: Priority Windows = short-lived priority bits in router (low-latency check). Surge Shield = routing to cheaper model or feature-skip path. Different infra cost profiles.

Rhea (DevEx): Console UX: allow route-level toggles, schedule windows, and show usage graph. For Surge Shield show fallback type selector (model | feature). Pilot UI can be minimal.

Samir (Sales): Customers asking for per-route controls. Sales pitch: "keep critical endpoints responsive during campaigns" for Priority Windows; "avoid 500s and control costs" for Surge Shield. Pilot incentives: free 500 credits or two free priority windows.

Vera (Legal): Legal redlines: do not advertise as SLO unless capacity reserved. For Surge Shield add explicit consent for traffic steering; require opt-in for steering to third-party or customer-hosted models. Add misuse clause.

Marta (Finance): Pricing suggestions: Priority Windows (time-based SKUs): PW-1H ($99/month for 4 one-hour windows), PAYG $0.05/min. Surge Shield credits: SS-1000 ($199/month), PAYG $0.20/credit. Flag deferred revenue for bundles.

Owen (Eng): Effort: Priority Windows soft-path ~2 sprints (routing + console hook). Surge Shield reuse model-pool plumbing ~2-3 sprints. Need kill-switch and canary rollout. Also tagging for cost attribution.

Nadia (PM): Proposed launch criteria: pilot with 2 customers, measurable reduction in 95th latency for Priority Windows (>=20% improvement), Surge Shield reduces user-visible errors by >=50% during spikes, platform cost impact <8% at 99th. No security/legal blockers.

Rhea (DevEx): For pilot, provide CLI + Console mock, simple API to attach windows/credits, and event feed. I'll mock this week.

Samir (Sales): I'll surface two customers: one ecom app with deploy-time spikes, one SaaS with seasonal campaigns. Will soft-pitch next week.

Vera (Legal): I'll draft pilot T&Cs with opt-in steering, no-hard-SLA wording, audit log requirement, and rollback clause.

ops-bot: Simulation queued: "Priority vs Surge pilot" job #9911. ETA ~3h. Will attach results here.

Nadia (PM): Actions: Owen -> tech spec + kill-switch; Rhea -> console mock & API; Vera -> pilot T&Cs; Marta -> refine SKU margins; Samir -> pilot customers. PRD draft by EOD Friday. Thanks!
